GLDIO.env.title: Scene environment
GLDIO.env.hint: Time of day, weather and air for this scene's 3D view. Changes show live for everyone at the table. Each player's Graphics settings decide how much of it their machine draws.
GLDIO.env.note.timeDarkness: Time follows this scene's darkness (Diorama settings). The hour here is not used.
GLDIO.env.note.timeCalendar: Time follows the calendar. The hour here is not used.
GLDIO.env.note.timeCalendarOff: Time should follow the calendar, but Clocks & Tracker is off, so the hour here is used.
GLDIO.env.note.dayNightOff: Day and night is off in your own Graphics settings, so you see table light. Players with it on see the hour.
GLDIO.env.note.weatherCalendar: Weather follows the Weather feature. Kind and intensity here are not used.
GLDIO.env.note.knownLayout: In the 3D view, ground nobody has seen yet shows as remembered: its shape, dim and grey under a light mist. Creatures there still stay hidden until someone can see them. Leave it off to keep unseen ground in the fog.
GLDIO.env.note.weatherCalendarOff: Weather should follow the Weather feature, but it is off or has no region, so the weather here is used.
GLDIO.env.note.tiles: Ground tiles lie on the 3D ground like decals. Tiles with an occlusion mode, or above the Level's top, become roofs that fade while a player's figure is inside. Turn tiles off here for a map whose tiles clash with the 3D board.
